transcript: Hi, I just wanted to say thank you, the technician was really helpful yesterday.
This is the third time my lift is broken and my mother cannot walk up eight floors. Fix it today or I am calling the town council.
你好，我想问一下下个月的垃圾收集时间有没有改变？
我已经等了两个小时了，没有人来，我很生气，我老公发烧很严重，需要马上帮助！
Selamat pagi, saya mau tanya jam buka kantor pada hari Sabtu.
Tolong cepat, majikan saya jatuh di kamar mandi dan tidak bisa bangun, saya sangat takut.
